title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full product detail by product ID (Shoptet GUID) or variant SKU: description, all parameters (e.g. width, depth, shape, series), downloadable documents, availability, rating and the product URL." → after: "Full product detail by product ID (Shoptet GUID) or variant SKU: title, full description, price in minor units (list_price when discounted), categories, image, brand, all parameters (e.g. width, depth, shape, series), downloadable documents, availability status and label (metadata.availability; rest"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
